title: Describe a Small Set of Survey Results

source.rights: 原创 AI 辅助虚构教学材料，尚待发布前独立审核。

instructions: Write your own first draft; the fictional example is for study, not your submission.
prompt: Write 120–160 words about a fictional community survey. Give the sample, describe two counts and one percentage, compare one earlier count, and explain one limitation. Use at least six lesson words and keep each denominator clear.

guidedOutput.title: 写作结构提示
guidedOutput.text: Write four parts: purpose and sample; current numbers; one comparison; limits and a cautious next step. Check that all categories add to the sample.

reference: Our community group asked twenty people to choose one improvement for a meeting room. The sample is small, and the results do not represent every resident. Twelve participants chose more seats, five chose an art display, and three chose more plants. The percentage for seats is sixty percent because twelve out of twenty selected that category. Art accounts for one quarter of the responses. In an earlier poll with a different group of twenty, eight people chose seats. The seat count increased from eight to twelve, while the art count remained at five. I would show the three current counts on a bar chart and explain the size of the sample beside it. Two rounds do not establish a long-term trend. Before making a decision, our group should survey more people and ask whether the room can safely hold additional chairs.
referenceLabel: 原创示例，仅供学习；不要作为自己的待提交作文。
